list: The official 55 trophies, verified 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PowerPyx

roadmap.text: Set your difficulty-free run up properly: keep a manual save at the start and the end of every chapter (PowerPyx suggests ten saves, two per chapter, out of fifteen slots) because there is no mission replay. The single trophy that can slip away lives in Chapter 1 — Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — so do it the first morning it is offered, before Chapter 1 ends. Leave cheats off entirely: guides report that cheats switch off trophy tracking and saving.
roadmap.title: Before you start: saves and the one missable trophy

roadmap.text: Play the story and let the side content come to you. Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study every new animal through the binoculars — the 100% checklist later wants 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and progress made now already counts. Start the questlines that open here (Kenton, Billy, Bret, Cal) as soon as they appear, and finish the arcade game and the fishing challenge while you are still in the early chapters.
roadmap.title: Chapters 1–2: the story, scanned and studied as you go

roadmap.text: Keep the story moving and pick up the questlines that unlock in these chapters — Andy, Randy, Tyrone and Yasmani's jobs. Once Chapter 2's Coffee Break lets Jason and Lucia roam together, the partner trophies open up: lose a four-star wanted level together, rob three shops back to back, and train strength side by side. This is also when the Key Cloner, the Dye Pack Jammer and the jewelry-store robberies unlock, so the showroom, bank and armored-truck trophies become possible.
roadmap.title: Chapters 3–4: story, side characters and the partner trophies

roadmap.text: Finish the story: the last chapter missions hand you the final story trophies, and the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' unlocks the bank-vault robberies that the Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play trophies need. After the credits the open world stays open and the 100% checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
roadmap.title: Chapter 5 and the finale

roadmap.text: With the story done, clear the questlines that are still open — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret all stay available in free roam — then work through the stranger strands that count toward the trophy: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counters, and you need eight strands in total.
roadmap.title: Side characters and Strangers & Freaks

roadmap.text: Now the map work: unfog every corner of Leonida from a plane, finish the WAiNK scans, complete three collectible card sets, meditate at the remaining spots, and hunt down the last vehicles. The UFO easter egg for The Truth Is Out There belongs here too — a night-time drive on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploring Leonida

roadmap.text: The long tail: 250 stunts, gold medals at all twelve shooting ranges, drone races at all fourteen locations, twenty different race wins, fifty of the eighty challenges — and the 100% checklist itself, which only asks for about sixty percent of true completion (seventy of eighty challenges, three hundred stunts, fifteen of eighteen meditations). Finish the checklist and A Long Road, the gold, pops — then the platinum follows.
roadmap.title: Activities, challenges and 100% completion

trophies.guide: The platinum arrives on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 in difficulty and roughly 200 hours, with a single playthrough enough. No online trophies and no DLC are involved.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: it pops when you finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, which opens Chapter 1. Just play the opening as the game presents it.

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every main mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — that one moment is the only thing in the whole game that can be missed (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete Chapter 4. It pops when the final main mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero, is done. The optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' is worth doing now too — it unlocks the bank-vault robberies.

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players will earn. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. The good news is how forgiving it is: it is closer to sixty percent of true completion — you need any 100 optional missions (there are far more), 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, and only some collectible types in full (all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests). Work through the other trophies first and most of the checklist will already be done.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game count, and you can mix the four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. PowerPyx calls flying under bridges the quickest kind. Track progress by region in the Progress menu under Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them in the Progress menu under Activities — scrolling over each one shows how many you have done. Most unlock naturally from the story and from working on the other trophies, so this one usually pops without being chased.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are twelve shooting ranges across Leonida with 42 challenges between them, and every one needs a gold medal — no silver or bronze will do. PowerPyx keeps a dedicated guide to all twelve locations and all 42 golds, so work through it range by range, easiest first. Shooting-range practice also raises your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy, and the ranges are required in full for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are fourteen Top Fun drone race locations, with 42 drone races in total, and you need a win at each location. PowerPyx lists all fourteen locations — clear them one by one, and the trophy pops at the last one. Drone races are also required for the 100% checklist, so they are not optional work.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win twenty different races — each race location counts once, so repeating the same one does not help. PowerPyx counts forty unique race locations in the game, including car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races. The 100% checklist asks for thirty wins, so keep racing past this trophy.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal during the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. Some time after that, Cal sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map — follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets. Fishing itself is one of the nine activity types for Master of None, and it also raises Focus.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: There are four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 onward; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all the levels of any one of them once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick the one you enjoy most.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3, when a call from Andy is followed by a text with her home address in Belville. Her five quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — finish the last one, Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse, and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens in Chapter 1, a while after the Island Dreams mission where you work for him — he calls, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure: seven shipwrecks in total, marked with purple chest icons, dug up with the metal detector on the ocean floor and brought back to him. He goes quiet during part of the story (as Jason in Chapter 2, calling Brian speeds his return), but every quest stays available after the story. Track him under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. His five quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — finish the last one and the trophy is yours. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Not every side questline counts as a stranger strand — the named character lines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) do not count toward this trophy. The confirmed counters are Kirk (the Skunk Ape chain), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street-racing chain) and Pilot Pete (the delivery chain), with more strangers still being found. They all stay available in free roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have finished.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants sixteen sports cars delivered — the list is under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List, and he marks some cars for you automatically. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is wanted, then drive it back to his garage in the west of Vice City in good condition for a better payout. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go and destroy them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good; finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are eighteen meditation spots across ten locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice toward the total — track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation happens only in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. That meditation adds one to the counter but is not marked as a spot like the others, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so do it to be safe. You cannot do the last meditation until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and opens some time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when a text from Bret marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do that quest and he starts marking hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed — PowerPyx notes it is unclear — but his fifteen Target Decks are all required for the 100% checklist, so the trophy should come naturally along the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: There are eighteen collectible card sets scattered around Leonida, and any three completed sets earn the trophy. PowerPyx keeps a guide to all eighteen set locations — work through the sets nearest to where you already are. The 100% checklist wants fifteen sets, so this trophy is only the start of the card hunt.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are objects in the world you scan by holding up on the D-pad and then R1. The scannable things are grouped as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the No Flusher tags — far more than a hundred in total, so any hundred will do. Scan as you travel and this pops on its own; the 100% checklist also wants exactly one hundred WAiNK locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Eighty challenges exist and you only need fifty for this trophy — ten more than needed, so skip the hardest ones. Track them under Progress, Challenges; the checkmark in the bottom-right of a challenge shows whether it is done. Many complete themselves while you work on the other trophies, so leave this one late and mop up the easiest remaining challenges. The 100% checklist wants seventy of eighty.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need Jason and Lucia together, which only becomes possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Build a four-star wanted level (causing carnage will do it), then escape the red heat zone on the map, not just the flashing blue-and-red search area. The easiest escape PowerPyx found is driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also tends to pop on its own during the bank-vault robberies, which always bring four stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Again you need your partner with you (after Coffee Break), and you must stay wanted the whole time — keep the flashing red-and-blue wanted level alive, not the red heat level, across three shop robberies in a row. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items from Ammu-Nation first. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, which open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each store and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it has not popped, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: The game has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold up on the D-pad to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. The fastest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy comes automatically.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is triggered with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must down five enemies in one use, which only lasts a few seconds, so prepare first — eat or drink to fill focus, take Adrenaline to stretch it (hold L1, then Triangle), and wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. Line up five enemies, ideally criminals at a gang operation, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 for full-auto accuracy. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels and rises as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and land headshots — by late game you will likely be at level four and this gets much easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside. Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backwards onto the airstrip, take off and fly at least a kilometre away from the airport — the unlock is slightly delayed. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — the Rhinos — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base: drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Climb in and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — that unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with a green icon on the map. Enter a store through the back door with the Snap Gun (the kick-the-door option sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm before you leave. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. The trophy pops shortly after you walk out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)' — it teaches the method and counts as your first vault. After that, pay Yasmani for tips about security vans ($10,000 a tip; you need his earlier Payday Loans jobs done first), follow a marked van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone — and hand off a bag with right on the D-pad. Robbing a vault instantly brings four stars, so have a fast motorcycle ready and switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are eight large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all eight; this trophy needs any five, and each one can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults — 'That's Where The Money Is…' — counts here too: tailing the security van and robbing the bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks, so block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests) and blow it open — then escape the red heat radius, using a Pay 'n' Spray if you need to. Either way, the trophy only pops once you are clear of the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx has a dedicated guide on unfogging the map fast and the best plane for it. Exploring also surfaces activity icons, stunt spots and robbery targets, so do it before the big cleanup stages.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are nine gangs and 39 illegal gang operations between them. You only need one operation from each gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it comes automatically if you clear them all. Operations show as yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you, and the trophy pops. It is one of the small flavor trophies — no mission or unlock needed, just the right bar and the right drink.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You can only take the car after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the Banshee, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving a little further down the street: the unlock is slightly delayed and only this specific blue Banshee counts.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). You first go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item — and if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can go back and grab the rest. Not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check it under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always work out together: call your partner with right on the D-pad plus Triangle, and while one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities (the dumbbell icon); there are plenty across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the game counts them, and you can see your running total by opening this trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile on) so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action registers. The profile has five tiers — Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — earned by how you behave: clean stealthy robberies, incapacitating enemies, killing, or outright rampages. Most of the 500 will happen passively while you do the robberies and fights the other trophies need; if you are short at the end, running over civilians and cops with a car farms it fast. One warning from the guides: Irredeemable is permanent, and at Psycho and above the police are more likely to shoot on sight.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Honest status, checked 19 November 2026: no public guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, and the leading guess in the community is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — the 'second time's the charm' hint suggests a retry of something that failed the first time. Check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates as players confirm it; this entry does not invent a method where none is documented.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: This one is the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, alone, at night after 2AM — the event is slightly random, so it may take a few visits. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, the event is live: follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO as a bright blue light in the sky. Walk toward it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside. The trophy pops then. If the blinking car is not there, drive away and come back later.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Honest status, checked 19 November 2026: no public guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, and the leading guess is that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by, as the description hints. Check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates as players confirm it; this entry does not invent a method where none is documented.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and carry the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all your deliveries, so you do not need to bring it in one trip. Bank vaults alone can hand you up to $205,000 in a single robbery once they unlock after Chapter 4's 'That's Where The Money Is…', and the total grows naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across every kind of shop — the total is cumulative, so it builds up over the whole playthrough. The fastest way to push it over the line is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so there is no shortage of places to spend.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages — the four story-related garages do not count. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when a notification tells you the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone; buy them through that app. Together they cost about $160,000, so fund them with robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4. Owning garages also adds parking spots, which the On the Spot trophy needs.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Buy enough garages first — each garage adds parking spots — then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. Early on he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
